assessment: Proposed tag isolation plus original fee ledger is viable with the following service-level invariants. Old financial settlement AST need not change.

risks_and_required_invariants.required: Source sanitized proposal facts and RouterBudget.settle(cost,usage,result=None) must commit in one original Engine outer transaction. On recovery known cost with no valid Source result is a known-invalid/unavailable attempt, not permission to call again.

risks_and_required_invariants.risk: Source unknown replay under fresh batch/config
risks_and_required_invariants.required: A durable original-input/group attempt identity must block a second physical call after unknown even if FastPath merges more members, policy/config changes, or caller invents new batch IDs. Reject stale commit and keep original unknown reservation; do not convert it to a free retry.

router_batches.snapshot and sa_source_eval_* immutable facts store only IDs/hashes/revisions/enums. Never call RouterBudget.response or put source/raw model response in ordinary CAS. Assemble current authorized text in bounded memory only; provider output must be schema restricted before durable recording.

All legacy prior/failed/cached paths exclude Source tag; wrap/validate/commit reject and save/failure cannot rewrite Source batches. New Source pipeline accepts only its exact fixed tag and ownership facts, not merely threads=[]. Legacy _rows has no snapshot parameter and remains unchanged.

Injected pipeline and decoder are trusted server composition and must be supplied together. Any protocol only carries opaque values between the selected runtime validators; it is not a model authority field. Source wrap/commit validates strict DTO and current Source identities, every revision/epoch and budget.

Continue original RouterBudget.reserve/settle and sa_budget_calls attribution in the same held Engine connection. Source call reservation must be revalidated immediately before attempt; known-invalid/stale outcomes still settle observed cost; no new financial table or custom settlement SQL.
Only reuse public SSEDecoder/ModelCapabilities/estimate_tokens through a private Source inference request. Never construct fake TaskBinding/Run/workspace or import H12.

Legacy Router metrics naturally include original Source financial router_calls if unchanged. Document as shared Router totals, or coordinate separately if legacy-only UI semantics are required; do not label those as old-Worker business-task counts.
